pages.text: SYN Market Wire weekly wrap for the week ending 2026-05-08. The SSE All-Share Index closed the week ending 2026-05-08 at 2,031.53 points. The 91-day Treasury bill auction that week cleared at 9.01 percent. Weekly turnover on the exchange was SYN Sh 2,235 million. The top gainer of the week was Safari Retail (SYN).

Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures.
